title: pleopeltis linguiformis
intro: Pleopeltis linguiformis, commonly known as the tongue fern, is a species of epiphytic fern native to Central and South America. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pleopeltis linguiformis are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can also help in the management of fever and pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
